Users Ops Reset Password
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id:resetpassword

Initiates a password reset for a specific user ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The user ID of the user for whom the password is to be reset.

Responses
​
200
400

The password reset request has been initiated successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
string
string
